title: The help center has nothing for the activity-first or evidence-first reader, supporters, hosting with kids or teaching across studios
detail:
PR 10 (ADR-1715). New help articles: something to do (run clubs, sauna and sober socials, game nights), a plain timer with no fluff, what Crew keeps free for others, hosting with kids, and teaching across several studios. Each indexed so pnpm check:help passes.

CLOSED 2026-10-06. Five new help articles, each indexed by its front matter: find-your-people/start-with-something-to-do.md (the activity-first reader: runs, walks, sauna and sober socials, game nights, Get Moving), find-your-people/just-the-timer.md (the evidence-first reader: Mindless with nothing attached, about six breaths a minute, research cited inside the long-form page), membership/what-crew-keeps-free.md (supporters: what Crew keeps free, contribute what you want), leading/hosting-with-kids.md, and spaces/teaching-across-studios.md (a free Space, ticketed workshops, the Contacts list). pnpm check:help passes.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")}catch{return ""}};const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};for(const p of ["content/help/find-your-people/start-with-something-to-do.md","content/help/find-your-people/just-the-timer.md","content/help/membership/what-crew-keeps-free.md","content/help/leading/hosting-with-kids.md","content/help/spaces/teaching-across-studios.md"])if(!/^---[\s\S]*?title:/.test(r(p)))fail("missing help article: "+p)'
verify.note: Fails while any of the five new help articles is missing or has no title front matter.
